shouldFix.title: The ROLELESS-NA repair reserves DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN for DEF-WIN while the operative coverage law still requires that disposition for deferred language-role cells
shouldFix.counterexample: Take a comparison-basis component with a non-TypeScript applicable DR-118 role. roleApplicability.previewFirstSlice says every such other role keeps a named deferred cell. fixtureDomainBasis.members places the role cell inside the FDB, and coverageLaw requires a D-002-deferred language-role cell to carry DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN. The v12-authored rolelessNaQualification simultaneously says that label is reserved for DEF-WIN; deferredSlots enumerates only DEF-WIN, and G16-14 says those slots are outside the FDB. A harness therefore cannot determine whether the required non-TypeScript role cell is an in-FDB deferred result, an outside-FDB deferred slot, or forbidden from using the only disposition coverageLaw assigns it.
shouldFix.measurement: The four clauses are literal and simultaneous. D-002 currently selects TypeScript alone, so this does not invalidate a current active-role result and is not a blocker. But the contract itself promises named cells for other DR-118 roles and gives mutually exclusive membership/disposition instructions for them. The contradiction is newly sharpened by the v12 parenthetical 'that label is reserved for DEF-WIN'.
shouldFix.risk: Successor harnesses can disagree on the closed corpus domain and qualification-neutral result for a named deferred role, defeating exact FDB reconciliation or silently dropping a cell the non-shrink law says must remain.
shouldFix.suggestedFix: Choose one model and make all four clauses agree: either enumerate deferred language-role slots outside the FDB alongside DEF-WIN and exclude them from effectiveRoleAxis, or keep them as FDB members under a distinct qualification-neutral role disposition. Reserve DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN only after the domain membership rule is unambiguous.

verdictStatement: REJECT. V12 closes the frozen v11 live-frame, Windows-provenance, ROLELESS-NA, finding-id-pairing, and historical-note defects, and its source pins, roster, selector, evidence joins, shared lanes, G16 classes, and anti-lockstep cases otherwise pass. The current D-002 active role is TypeScript alone, so this is SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker, but it leaves the closed-domain/result contract nondeterministic and fails the required 0/0 threshold.
